feat(facts): one SessionFacts per session, assembled from today's providers and restamped (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6) (#611)

* feat(facts): a session's facts document is assembled from today's providers and restamped against its last (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

* docs(facts): the facts document's traps in data-sources memory; payloadOf comments follow its split (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

* review(facts): equality has one judge, the view derives its inputs once (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

assembleFacts compares builtins and sources by the identity restamp already
returns, instead of walking every value a second time. The session source
derives its payload inputs once for both the payload and the readings.
Stale updateOf comment and a shadowed stop are fixed.

* review(facts): Wire refuses undefined, projectPayload keeps one header (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.af6)

JSON drops an undefined property and nulls an undefined array member, so a
type admitting it does not round-trip as itself.
